Mctt.Core.Syntactic.System.Definitions

The Syntactic Judgments

Substitution is a meta-level operation rather than a syntactic constructor, so:
  • there is no wf_exp_sub rule and there are no _sub computation rules; how a substitution distributes over each term former, how substitutions compose and what the identity does are theorems about exp_sub, proved in Core.Syntactic.Substitution and used by rewrite;
  • the four judgments about terms (context well-formedness, typing, term equality and subtyping) mention no substitution judgment, and are mutually defined with the six about units, extensions, module expressions and the global context;
  • weakening and substitution typing are derived judgments: statements that an operation maps every binding of one context to something of the right type in the other. Their closure properties (identity, extension, lifting, composition) are lemmas, in Core.Syntactic.System.Structural.
One rule is stated more generally than in the paper:
  • wf_subtyp_pi checks the codomains in Γ ▹ A' rather than Γ ▹ A. The two are interderivable given Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Typeω@i and context conversion, and Γ ▹ A' is what the soundness proof wants.
Every judgment reads the two global components a global resolves in: the filed units Θ and the definition stack Ξ, as in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A. They are indices, not parameters: no rule about terms changes them, but a filed unit is checked against the units before it and a stack frame against the frames outside it, so ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ is an induction that varies them, as ⊢ Γ varies Γ.

Generalizable All Variables.

Context Lookup

A lookup carries the weakenings that separate the binding from the top of the context, so Var below needs no shifting of its own. The shift here is the weakening ↑, not the substitution Wk: everything that has to move a looked-up type past a lifted operation does so with exp_wk_shift_wk_q or exp_wk_shift_sub_q, both of which are stated for ↑.

Inductive ctx_lookup : nat -> typ -> ctx -> Prop :=
  | here : `(Γ ▹ A ∋ #0 : A[↑]ʷ)
  | here_def : `(Γ ▸ A ≔ M ∋ #0 : A[↑]ʷ)
  | there : `(Γ ∋ #n : A -> e :: Γ ∋ #(S n) : A[↑]ʷ)
where "Γ ∋ '#' x : A" := (ctx_lookup x A Γ) : type_scope.

The body of a definition entry, weakened to the use site like its type.
Inductive ctx_lookup_def : nat -> typ -> exp -> ctx -> Prop :=
  | def_here : `(Γ ▸ A ≔ M ∋ #0 ≔ M[↑]ʷ : A[↑]ʷ)
  | def_there : `(Γ ∋ #n ≔ M : A -> e :: Γ ∋ #(S n) ≔ M[↑]ʷ : A[↑]ʷ)
where "Γ ∋ '#' x ≔ M : A" := (ctx_lookup_def x A M Γ) : type_scope.

Shapes of Units

A telescope of parameters has assumptions only (tele_ass, with the member types in Members).
Two bodies compared entry by entry: the same names and kinds in the same order, the same privacy, and transparent definitions with a body; and local opens at the same places, with the same items.
Definition entry_shape (E E' : gentry) : Prop :=
  match E, E' with
  | ge_def b pv _ (Some _), ge_def b' pv' _ (Some _) => b = true /\ b' = true /\ pv = pv'
  | ge_mod pv _, ge_mod pv' _ => pv = pv'
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Fixpoint body_shape (Φ Φ' : gmod) : Prop :=
  match Φ, Φ' with
  | gm_nil, gm_nil => True
  | gm_ext Φ x E, gm_ext Φ' x' E' => body_shape Φ Φ' /\ x = x' /\ entry_shape E E'
  | gm_open Φ _ its, gm_open Φ' _ its' => body_shape Φ Φ' /\ its = its'
  | _, _ => False
  end.

The annotation of a local definition, if any, is the type it is checked at; without one, the type is any its body has.
Definition let_ann (oA : option typ) (A : typ) : Prop := oA = None \/ oA = Some A.

A rank rk of the members of a group D: 0 at a declared member, and below a view's at every member the view nests through in any block the eliminator at the view reads (one per member i' of the container's group, the block of the member v the view takes it to). The readback of a stuck eliminator at a view reads its branches with the eliminator at those members applied to fresh variables; the rank makes that recursion well founded.
Record view_rank_ok (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (D : ind_decl) (rk : nat -> nat) : Prop := mk_view_rank_ok
  {
A declared member has rank 0
    vro_decl : forall k Mk pm, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_decl pm -> rk k = 0
    
A view's rank is above that of every member it nests through, in every block the eliminator at the view reads
  ; vro_nest : forall k Mk qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' v Mv c gs' gs, ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
      im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm -> ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' -> ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' ->
      List.nth_error vm i' = Some v -> ind_member D v = Some Mv -> ind_con Mi' c = Some gs' -> ind_con Mv c = Some gs ->
      cargs_nest_ok rk (rk k) gs' gs }.

vmv is the map of the view of D that a view with map vm takes the container's member M to: vm itself at a declared M; at a view M with map vm'', vm'' followed by vm, each of its members one vm maps.
Definition view_map_at (vm : list nat) (M : imember) (vmv : list nat) : Prop :=
  match im_head M with
  | mh_decl _ => vmv = vm
  | mh_view _ _ _ vm'' => List.map (List.nth_error vm) vm'' = List.map Some vmv
  end.

The views of a group agree on their maps: of a view k with map vm and a member i' of its container, the member v of D vm takes i' to is a view of map view_map_at vm Mi'. The core command collects one view per instance, with its siblings, so the groups it builds have it; the eliminator at a view and the one at its container read a neutral alike only with it.
Definition view_maps_coherent (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (D : ind_decl) : Prop :=
  forall k Mk qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' v Mv qv kv Iv vmv,
    ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
    ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' -> ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' ->
    List.nth_error vm i' = Some v -> ind_member D v = Some Mv -> im_head Mv = mh_view qv kv Iv vmv ->
    view_map_at vm Mi' vmv.

The Mutually Defined Judgments

Four about terms, three about units, extensions and module expressions, and three about the global context. All ten are one Inductive … with …: an entry's type and body are checked by the term judgments, so presupposition has to be proved for all of them at once.

Inductive wf_ctx : gdeps -> gstack -> ctx -> Prop :=
The base case carries what the judgment is relative to, as wf_gmod_nil and wf_gstack_nil do; wf_ctx_extend then needs no context premise of its own, since typing its head presupposes one. This is the edge that makes the block genuinely mutual in both directions: a term appeals to ⊢ᵍ, and ⊢ᵍ is checked by the term judgments.
| wf_ctx_empty :
  `( ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ ->
     ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ⋅ )
| wf_ctx_extend :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
     ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ A )
| wf_ctx_extend_def :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
     ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▸ A ≔ M )
A module slot holds a well-formed unit.
| wf_ctx_extend_mod :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U ->
     ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ₘ U )
where "⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ" := (wf_ctx Θ Ξ Γ) : type_scope

with wf_exp : gdeps -> gstack -> ctx -> typ -> exp -> Prop :=
A large universe is in the next one.
| wf_typ :
  `( ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Typeω@i : Typeω@(S i) )
A small universe at a level is in the small universe at the next one. The level is an arbitrary term, so a universe may be indexed by a variable.
| wf_univ :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : Level@n ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨M⟩ : Type⟨succl M⟩ )
Every type of levels is small, at the least level.
| wf_level :
  `( ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Level@n : Type@0 )
A level is a literal, a successor, or a join. Level@n is the type of the levels below ω·(n+1), so a literal is of the sorts at least its tier.
| wf_llit :
  `( fst o <= n ->
     ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ 𝕃ᵒ o : Level@n )
The successor of a level.
| wf_succl :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : Level@n ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ succl M : Level@n )
The join of two levels.
| wf_maxl :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : Level@n ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N : Level@n ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ maxl M N : Level@n )
The unit type is small, at the least level.
| wf_True :
  `( ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ ⊤ : Type@0 )
The unit's only element.
| wf_true :
  `( ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ ⋆ : ⊤ )
The empty type is small, at the least level.
| wf_False :
  `( ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ ⊥ : Type@0 )
Elimination of the empty type, at a motive over it.
| wf_exfalso :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ ⊥ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : ⊥ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ efq M return A : A[Id,,M] )
The type former of a declared member of a group of inductive types, of the type the declaration gives: a Π over its parameters of the sort.
| wf_ind :
  `( ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D ->
     ind_member D k = Some M ->
     k < ind_ndecl D ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_ind p k : ind_ty D M )
A constructor of a member: a Π over the parameters and the arguments of the member at the parameters. At a view, the view's own parameters and arguments, into the container's member at the view's arguments: the normal form of a value read at a view (wf_exp_eq_con_view). The type is a closed type, of a well-formed context of arguments, and the rest of the type of a recursive argument after any number of its shape's domains is a type, under those domains: all follow from the declaration, and are premises so that the semantic models read them off the derivation.
| wf_con :
  `( ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D ->
     ind_member D k = Some M ->
     ind_con M c = Some gs ->
     ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ cargs_ctx p D M gs ++ im_params D M ->
     (forall gs1 t gs2 j, gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 -> j <= List.length (ptyp_doms t) ->
        ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ (sh_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (List.firstn j (ptyp_doms t)) ++ cargs_ctx p D M gs1 ++ im_params D M)
                  ▹ ptyp_ty p D (im_nn M) (List.repeat false j ++ cargs_pat gs1) (ptyp_skip j t)) ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ⋅ ⊢ con_ty p D k M gs : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_con p k c : con_ty p D k M gs )
The eliminator of the group at p, at the member m, at the parameters Ps (the group's uniform ones, then the member's non-uniform ones): one block per member of the group, in order, each with its motive under the member's non-uniform parameters and the scrutinee, an annotation, if any, the member's type there, and its branches, one per constructor in order, under the non-uniform parameters, the constructor's arguments and the recursive results, the result of an argument recursive in the member j being at the motive of j. The parameters are typed one by one, at the instances of their telescope. The eliminator carries the uniform parameters Us, those of the scrutinee's type: the scrutinee and each annotated block are at the members' types at them.
| wf_elim :
  `( ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D ->
     elim_grp D oq p m ->
     ind_member D m = Some Mm ->
     List.nth_error Bks m = Some bm ->
     List.length Bks = List.length (ind_members D) ->
     List.length Ps = im_np D Mm ->
     (forall k P T, nth_error Ps k = Some P -> nth_error (tele_insts (im_params D Mm) Id Ps) k = Some T ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ P : T) ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : ind_mty p D m (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps) ->
     Us = List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps ->
     (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b -> eb_nm b = S (im_nn Mk)) ->
     (forall k Mk b Z, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b -> eb_ann b = Some Z ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ▹ Z
                     ≈ elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->
     (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ ⊢ eb_motive b : Typeω@i) ->
     (forall k Mk, ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ≈ elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->
     (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b -> brs_names (im_cons Mk) (eb_brs b)) ->
     (forall k Mk c gs, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_bctx p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)
                     ≈ elim_bctx p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->
     (forall k Mk b c gs n B, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
        ind_con Mk c = Some gs -> In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) ->
        n = (im_nn Mk + List.length gs + cargs_nrec gs)%nat) ->
     (forall k Mk b c gs n B, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
        ind_con Mk c = Some gs -> In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_bctx p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ ⊢ B
          : elim_bty p k Mk c gs (eb_motive b) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_elim oq Us m Bks M : (eb_motive bm)[sb_of_list Id (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps ++ M :: nil)] )
A Π is in a universe its domain and codomain are in, small or large. The codomain's universe is the weakening of the domain's: a universe that mentions the bound variable has no name here.
| wf_pi :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵤ U ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : U ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ A ⊢ B : U[↑]ʷ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Π A B : U )
A λ-abstraction, over a type.
| wf_fn :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ A ⊢ M : B ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ λ A M : Π A B )
An application, at the codomain instantiated by the argument.
| wf_app :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ A ⊢ B : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : Π A B ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N : A ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M $ N : B[Id,,N] )
A local definition, of its annotated type or of a type its body has.
| wf_let :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▸ A ≔ M ⊢ B : C ->
     let_ann oA A ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_let (b_def oA M) B : C[Id,,M] )
A local module occupies one index, a slot holding its unit. The body's type is premised to be a type, as the canonical type of wf_mem is: equivalent substitutions are moved through the body by ζ, and the two sides then meet at that type.
| wf_let_mod :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ₘ U ⊢ C : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ₘ U ⊢ B : C ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ ℓₘ U in B : C[Id ,,ₘ me_lit U] )
A member: the module expression is well formed and looks the member up (mdenote of the selection) as a term, at the type the lookup reads. This is the only typing rule for members. The type is premised to be a type, as the induction moving a typing along equivalent substitutions needs it, and the δ-reduct, if any, to inhabit it, as soundness needs it. A filed axiom or abstract definition read bare has no δ-reduct (ds_named), so the premise never asks for the member itself.
| wf_mem :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H ->
     mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H x) R ->
     ds_ty Θ Ξ R = Some A ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
     (forall M, ds_red R = Some M -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A) ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_mem H x : A )
A variable, at the type the context gives it.
| wf_vlookup :
  `( ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     Γ ∋ #x : A ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ #x : A )
Subsumption: a term is at every type above its type.
| wf_exp_subtyp :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
     
This premise is needed for soundness. It is asymmetric: only A' is checked. Checking A as well would make even Γ ⊢ Typeω@0[↑]ʷ : Typeω@1 underivable, since weakening it would require Γ ⊢ Typeω@1[↑]ʷ : Typeω@2, which requires Γ ⊢ Typeω@2[↑]ʷ : Typeω@3, and so on.
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A' : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A' )
where "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A" := (wf_exp Θ Ξ Γ A M) : type_scope

with wf_exp_eq : gdeps -> gstack -> ctx -> typ -> exp -> exp -> Prop :=

Congruence rules

| wf_exp_eq_typ_cong :
  `( ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Typeω@i ≈ Typeω@i : Typeω@(S i) )
| wf_exp_eq_univ_cong :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Level@n ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨M⟩ ≈ Type⟨M'⟩ : Type⟨succl M⟩ )
| wf_exp_eq_level_cong :
  `( ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Level@n ≈ Level@n : Type@0 )
| wf_exp_eq_llit_cong :
  `( fst o <= n ->
     ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ 𝕃ᵒ o ≈ 𝕃ᵒ o : Level@n )
| wf_exp_eq_succl_cong :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Level@n ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ succl M ≈ succl M' : Level@n )
| wf_exp_eq_maxl_cong :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Level@n ->

     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ maxl M N ≈ maxl M' N' : Level@n )

The Level Equations

Levels are a join semilattice with a least element and an inflationary successor that distributes over the join; the literal ω·a + b is the b-th successor of the limit ω·a, and the limit ω·(n+1) is above every level of sort n (absorption). These are the equations of Danielsson–Favier–Kubánek Fig. 2 and absorption, and they are complete for the canonical forms of Core.Syntactic.Levels.Levels: two levels are equal exactly when they have the same canonical form.

The eliminator, its blocks and its scrutinee varying: the blocks are compared position by position, their annotations each checked, their branches position by position, at the left motives. The groups as written may differ (one of them taken from the scrutinee's type).

ι: the eliminator on a constructor is the constructor's branch, at the non-uniform parameters, the arguments and the recursive results (elim_ihs): the eliminator at a recursive argument, and at one of a function shape λ x. elim (f x). The arguments are typed one by one, at the instances of their telescope at the parameters.

The eliminator at a view is the eliminator of the view's own group at the container's member, its blocks those of the members of this group that are the container's group's members at the view's arguments (vwrap, E1′): a stuck eliminator at a view is a stuck one of the container, at the container's uniform parameters (the view's arguments) when the container's group has views too.

        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ≈ elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->

A constructor of a view at the group's uniform parameters Us is the container's constructor at the view's arguments there, both sides at the same type.

     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▸ A ≔ M ⊢ B : C ->
     let_ann oA A ->

ζ for local modules: the slot is replaced by the unit.

     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A' : Typeω@i ->
     
This premise mirrors the one of wf_exp_subtyp.

Subtyping

with wf_subtyp : gdeps -> gstack -> ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| wf_subtyp_refl :
  
This premise lets the presupposition lemmas be proved independently: it gives presupposition for the right-hand side directly.
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M' : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ⊆ M' )
| wf_subtyp_trans :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ⊆ M' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M' ⊆ M'' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ⊆ M'' )
| wf_subtyp_univ :
  `( ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     i < j ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Typeω@i ⊆ Typeω@j )
A small universe below one at a larger level. The order on levels is maxl M M' ≈ M', which is decidable on canonical forms (Core.Syntactic.Levels.Levels.lvl_le) and never the order on realisers.
| wf_subtyp_suniv :
  
The two typings let the presupposition lemmas be proved independently, as in wf_subtyp_refl.
  `( ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : Level@n ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M' : Level@n ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ maxl M M' ≈ M' : Level@n ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨M⟩ ⊆ Type⟨M'⟩ )
A type of levels is below every type of levels of a larger sort: every level of a sort is a level of each larger one.
| wf_subtyp_level :
  `( m <= n ->
     ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Level@m ⊆ Level@n )
A small universe below every large one.
| wf_subtyp_small_large :
  `( ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : Level@n ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨M⟩ ⊆ Typeω@i )
| wf_subtyp_pi :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A' : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ A ⊢ B : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ A' ⊢ B' : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ A' ⊢ B ⊆ B' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Π A B ⊆ Π A' B' )
where "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A'" := (wf_subtyp Θ Ξ Γ A A') : type_scope

Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵤ U: U is a universe, large or small at a level of Γ.

Modules

Equivalence of modules is pointwise: two units are equivalent when their entries are, one by one and in the same order, and two module expressions when their parts are. Well-formedness is the reflexive instance.
Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' compares two extensions of Γ entry by entry. An entry is compared in the left extension; the right one's entry is also typed in the right extension, so that presupposition needs no context conversion.
with wf_ext_eq : gdeps -> gstack -> ctx -> ctx -> ctx -> Prop :=
| wf_ext_eq_nil :
  `( ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ ⋅ ≈ ⋅ )
| wf_ext_eq_ass :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ' ++ Γ ⊢ A' : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ▹ A ≈ Ψ' ▹ A' )
| wf_ext_eq_def :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ' ++ Γ ⊢ A' : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ' ++ Γ ⊢ M' : A' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ▸ A ≔ M ≈ Ψ' ▸ A' ≔ M' )
| wf_ext_eq_mod :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ' ++ Γ ⊢ᵘ U' ≈ U' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ▹ₘ U ≈ Ψ' ▹ₘ U' )
where "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ'" := (wf_ext_eq Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ') : type_scope

Units. Each side of a body unit is well formed where it stands: its body, read as the entries its local opens generate (body_xp), and its parameters form an extension of Γ, and the target of each open is a module there. The two sides have the same shape as written, opens at the same places with the same items, and as expanded (body_shape), and are compared entry by entry through their expansions; the targets of the opens are compared pairwise, filled in like the entries. Each entry is compared with the entries before it filled in (gm_fill: a definition by its body, a module by its unit), in the left parameters' context, and each filled-in entry of the right side is typed in the right parameters' context, as the parts of an extension are: so the comparison never reads one side's entries in the other side's body. Every entry can be filled in: a local body has no bodiless definition and no inductive type. The level of the type of the definition named y is lv y.
with wf_unit_eq : gdeps -> gstack -> ctx -> gunit -> gunit -> Prop :=
| wf_unit_eq_body :
  `( body_xp Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) Φ Φx ->
     body_xp Θ Ξ (Δ' ++ Γ) Φ' Φx' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Δ ≈ Δ' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ body_ctx Φx ++ Δ ≈ body_ctx Φx ++ Δ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ body_ctx Φx' ++ Δ' ≈ body_ctx Φx' ++ Δ' ->
     (forall y Φ0 b pv A M Φ0' b' pv' A' M' σ σ',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y (ge_def b pv A (Some M))) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y (ge_def b' pv' A' (Some M'))) ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σ -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σ' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ A[σ] : Typeω@(lv y)) ->
     (forall y Φ0 b pv A M Φ0' b' pv' A' M' σ σ',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y (ge_def b pv A (Some M))) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y (ge_def b' pv' A' (Some M'))) ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σ -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σ' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ A'[σ'] : Typeω@(lv y)) ->
     (forall y Φ0 b pv A M Φ0' b' pv' A' M' σ σ',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y (ge_def b pv A (Some M))) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y (ge_def b' pv' A' (Some M'))) ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σ -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σ' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ M[σ] : A[σ]) ->
     (forall y Φ0 b pv A M Φ0' b' pv' A' M' σ σ',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y (ge_def b pv A (Some M))) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y (ge_def b' pv' A' (Some M'))) ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σ -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σ' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ M[σ] ≈ M'[σ'] : A[σ]) ->
     (forall y Φ0 pv U Φ0' pv' U' σ σ',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y (ge_mod pv U)) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y (ge_mod pv' U')) ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σ -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σ' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ᵘ U[σ]ᵘ ≈ U'[σ']ᵘ) ->
     (forall y Φ0 b pv A M Φ0' b' pv' A' M' σ σ',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y (ge_def b pv A (Some M))) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y (ge_def b' pv' A' (Some M'))) ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σ -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σ' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ' ++ Γ ⊢ A'[σ'] : Typeω@(lv y)) ->
     (forall y Φ0 b pv A M Φ0' b' pv' A' M' σ σ',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y (ge_def b pv A (Some M))) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y (ge_def b' pv' A' (Some M'))) ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σ -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σ' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ' ++ Γ ⊢ M'[σ'] : A'[σ']) ->
     (forall y Φ0 pv U Φ0' pv' U' σ σ',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y (ge_mod pv U)) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y (ge_mod pv' U')) ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σ -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σ' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ' ++ Γ ⊢ᵘ U'[σ']ᵘ ≈ U'[σ']ᵘ) ->
     (forall k Ψ H, nth_error (body_opens Φ Φx) k = Some (Ψ, H) -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H) ->
     (forall k Ψ' H', nth_error (body_opens Φ' Φx') k = Some (Ψ', H') -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ' ++ Δ' ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ H' ≈ H') ->
     (forall k Φ0 H Φ0' H' σ σ',
        nth_error (body_opens_at Φ Φx) k = Some (Φ0, H) ->
        nth_error (body_opens_at Φ' Φx') k = Some (Φ0', H') ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σ -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σ' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ H[σ]ᵐ ≈ H'[σ']ᵐ) ->
     (forall k Φ0 H Φ0' H' σ σ',
        nth_error (body_opens_at Φ Φx) k = Some (Φ0, H) ->
        nth_error (body_opens_at Φ' Φx') k = Some (Φ0', H') ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σ -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σ' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ' ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ H'[σ']ᵐ ≈ H'[σ']ᵐ) ->
     tele_ass Δ ->
     tele_ass Δ' ->
     List.length Δ = List.length Δ' ->
     body_shape Φ Φ' ->
     body_shape Φx Φx' ->
     List.NoDup (gm_names Φ) ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_open Δ Φ ≈ gu_open Δ' Φ' )
| wf_unit_eq_alias :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Δ ≈ Δ' ->
     tele_ass Δ ->
     tele_ass Δ' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ' ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ E' ≈ E' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_mk Δ (md_alias E) ≈ gu_mk Δ' (md_alias E') )
An alias of a literal is the literal over both telescopes, the alias's outermost: the merge lookup performs (un_alias, ds_up). The alias's parameters form an extension of Γ, and the literal is a unit under them.
| wf_unit_eq_flatten :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Δ ≈ Δ ->
     tele_ass Δ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_mk Δ' D ≈ gu_mk Δ' D ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_mk Δ (md_alias (me_lit (gu_mk Δ' D))) ≈ gu_mk (Δ' ++ Δ) D )
| wf_unit_eq_sym :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U' ≈ U )
| wf_unit_eq_trans :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U' ≈ U'' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U'' )
where "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U'" := (wf_unit_eq Θ Ξ Γ U U') : type_scope

Module expressions. A module expression is a module when the module part of what it denotes has a telescope (ds_mtele), and an argument is checked against the outermost parameter of that telescope (tele_view): a module is applied to at most as many arguments as it has parameters. Both arguments are typed, as the parts of an extension are, and so is the parameter's type.
with wf_modexp_eq : gdeps -> gstack -> ctx -> modexp -> modexp -> Prop :=

Congruence

A loaded unit or an open frame.
| wf_me_unit :
  `( ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     gc_unit Θ Ξ (me_unit fp) = Some TΦ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_unit fp ≈ me_unit fp )
| wf_me_var :
  `( ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     Γ ∋ #x ≔ₘ U ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_var x ≈ me_var x )
| wf_me_lit :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_lit U ≈ me_lit U' )
A selection: on both sides the member is a module, by what the selection denotes (mdenote), the module part having a telescope.
| wf_me_mem :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' ->
     mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H y) R ->
     ds_mtele Θ Ξ R = Some T ->
     mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H' y) R' ->
     ds_mtele Θ Ξ R' = Some T' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_mem H y ≈ me_mem H' y )
An application: the argument is checked against the outermost parameter of the telescope of what the module expression denotes.
| wf_me_app :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' ->
     mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H R ->
     ds_mtele Θ Ξ R = Some T ->
     tele_view T = Some (B, T1) ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ B : Typeω@i ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N : B ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N ≈ N' : B ->
     mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H' R' ->
     ds_mtele Θ Ξ R' = Some T' ->

     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N' : B' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_app H N ≈ me_app H' N' )

δ

A slot is its unit.
| wf_me_delta_slot :
  `( ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
     Γ ∋ #x ≔ₘ U ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_var x ≈ me_lit U )
A module member is the unit the module part of what the selection looks up stands for (ds_unit): a body module of a filed module, the filed module at its own path; an alias, its target's; a module of a local body, its literal with the entries before it filled in.

  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_mem H y ≈ me_mem H y ->

β

A literal body or alias given its outermost parameter is the literal instantiated; an alias with no parameter is its target.

  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_mk (Δ ++ ce_ass X :: nil) (md_body sm_open Φ) ≈ gu_mk (Δ ++ ce_ass X :: nil) (md_body sm_open Φ) ->

| wf_me_trans :

Well-formedness of the Global Context

Part of the same mutual definition: an entry's type and body are checked by the term judgments, and a use of a global appeals to ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ.
A unit is checked against the units filed before it, and a frame against the frames outside it, which is why both components are indices of the whole block.
A member of a parameterized module is checked in the telescope of parameters it lives under, and stored generalized over it (ctx_pi, ctx_fn). ge_mod records only the parameters it adds to that telescope; a gunit records all of it, which is why a unit is checked at ⋅.
Canonicity is part of well-formedness: wf_gmod_ext asks for freshness, so a well-formed context resolves deterministically without a separate condition.
An entry is checked against the current module, which is the head of Ξ: that frame is what wf_gmod_ext pushed, and it carries the parameters and the members declared so far. The local context is the telescope of all the frames' parameters, gs_tele Ξ: parameters are ordinary λ-variables. A definition is stored generalized over that telescope, so what is filed is closed, and nothing has to be done to it when it is read anywhere else. mp is the entry's own module path, which a nested module's frame is named by.

with wf_gentry : gdeps -> gstack -> qname -> gentry -> Prop :=
A definition or an axiom: its type is a type, and its body, if it has one, carries the type.
| wf_gentry_def :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
     (forall M, oM = Some M -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ M : A) ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ ge_def b pv (ctx_pi (gs_tele Ξ) A) (option_map (ctx_fn (gs_tele Ξ)) oM) )
An internal module, under the parameters Δ' it declares.
| wf_gentry_mod :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ Δ' ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ ge_body pv Δ' Φ )
An alias, under the parameters Δ it declares. It is filed with its full telescope, so that it is closed; its target is checked, and its arguments with it, where it is declared.
| wf_gentry_alias :
  `( tele_ass Δ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ˣ Δ ≈ Δ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ ge_mod pv (gu_mk (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) (md_alias E)) )
A group of inductive types, at its first member, before the members of its module: its declaration, with uniform parameters Δ over the frames' parameters. The sort is checked in the uniform parameters; for each member, declared or view, its non-uniform parameters at the sort, a non-recursive argument of a constructor in the member's parameters and the non-recursive arguments before it, at the sort, and a recursive argument by its shape: each domain of a function shape there and under the domains before it, at the sort, and the non-uniform parameters of the member it ends in under all its domains. A view of the declared member k' of the filed group at qc at Is: Is are that group's uniform parameters, its siblings are the views vm lists, its non-uniform parameters those of the container's member at Is, its constructors the container's at Is (the view equations), classified for this group (cargs_corr), and its sort in this group's. The types are not filed yet, so no argument mentions them but as a recursive argument: positivity is by construction. No type of the declaration has a free module variable (decl_mvc), as no type in a context of assumptions.

A later declared member of a group, before the members of its module: the group is filed at its first member, y0, an entry of the same module before it.
| wf_gentry_ind_mem_nil :
  `( ind_uparams D = Δu ++ gs_tele ((mq, gu_body Δ Φ0) :: Ξ) ->
     tele_ass (ind_uparams D) ->
     ⊢ Θ ⍮ (mq, gu_body Δ Φ0) :: Ξ ⍮ ind_uparams D ->
     gm_entry Φ0 (y0 :: nil) = Some (ge_ind pv0 (qname_in mq y0) 0 D Φm) ->
     ind_lookup Θ ((mq, gu_body Δ Φ0) :: Ξ) (qname_in mq y0) = Some D ->
     ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
     0 < k ->
     k < ind_ndecl D ->
     im_head Mk = mh_decl (qname_in mq y) ->
     Θ ⍮ (mq, gu_body Δ Φ0) :: Ξ ⍮ qname_in mq y ⊢ᵉ ge_ind pv (qname_in mq y0) k D ⋄ )
One more member of the module of a member of a group of inductive types, a definition: it is checked with the entry so far declared in the innermost frame, under the uniform parameters, the module's (ind_unit), and stored generalized over them, so that it is closed.
| wf_gentry_ind_ext :
  `( Θ ⍮ (mq, gu_body Δ Φ0) :: Ξ ⍮ qname_in mq y ⊢ᵉ ge_ind pv pq k D Φ ->
     Θ ⍮ (mq, gu_body Δ (Φ0 ⊳ y ↦ ge_ind pv pq k D Φ)) :: Ξ ⍮ ind_uparams D ⊢ M : A ->
     gm_fresh x Φ ->
     Θ ⍮ (mq, gu_body Δ Φ0) :: Ξ ⍮ qname_in mq y
       ⊢ᵉ ge_ind pv pq k D (Φ ⊳ x ↦ ge_def b pv' (ctx_pi (ind_uparams D) A) (Some (ctx_fn (ind_uparams D) M))) )
An inductive alias with parameters Δ over the frames' parameters, of the declared member k of the group at p, its module at pm, at arguments Ns for its first uniform parameters; it is stored over its full telescope, as an alias is.
| wf_gentry_ind_alias :
  `( tele_ass Δ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ˣ Δ ≈ Δ ->
     ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D ->
     ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
     k < ind_ndecl D ->
     ind_mpath D k = Some pm ->
     ind_mlookup Θ Ξ pm = Some (p, k, D) ->
     List.length Ns <= ind_nu D ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ apps (a_ind p k) Ns : ind_ty_at D Mk Ns ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ᵐ me_apps (qname_mod pm) Ns ≈ me_apps (qname_mod pm) Ns ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ ge_ind_alias pv (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) pm p k Ns )
where "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ E" := (wf_gentry Θ Ξ mp E) : type_scope

The module at path mp, with own parameters Δ, a telescope over the frames' parameters gs_tele Ξ.
with wf_gmod : gdeps -> gstack -> qname -> ctx -> gmod -> Prop :=
| wf_gmod_nil :
  `( tele_ass Δ ->
     ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ ⋄ )
The entry is checked against the members declared before it: the module so far is gu_mk Δ Φ, pushed as the innermost frame under its own path.
| wf_gmod_ext :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ ->
     Θ ⍮ (mp, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ ⍮ qname_in mp x ⊢ᵉ E ->
     gm_fresh x Φ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ ⊳ x ↦ E )
where "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ" := (wf_gmod Θ Ξ mp Δ Φ) : type_scope

The filed units Θ and the stack Ξ of open frames, innermost first. A frame is checked against the frames outside it, and a unit is filed by closing the only open frame, named by its path, after which it is checked against the units filed before it. So a unit sees no stack and not itself, and a qu_rel index inside a frame counts outward from there. Freshness (frame_fresh) makes a path filed at most once.

with wf_gstack : gdeps -> gstack -> Prop :=
| wf_gstack_nil : ⊢ᵍ nil ⍮ nil
| wf_gstack_file :
  `( ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ (q_abs fp nil, U) :: nil ->
     ⊢ᵍ (fp, U) :: Θ ⍮ nil )
| wf_gstack_cons :
  `( ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ ->
     frame_fresh Θ Ξ mp ->
     ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ (mp, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ )
where "⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ" := (wf_gstack Θ Ξ) : type_scope.

The schemes are Minimality, not Induction: nothing in this development is proved by a statement that mentions the derivation itself, and dropping the derivation arguments keeps the goals of a mutual induction readable and within reach of mauto.
A Scheme may name any subset of the block, and the judgments it leaves out survive as ordinary hypotheses in the cases that mention them.

Scheme wf_ctx_mut_ind := Minimality for wf_ctx Sort Prop
with wf_exp_mut_ind := Minimality for wf_exp Sort Prop
with wf_exp_eq_mut_ind := Minimality for wf_exp_eq Sort Prop
with wf_subtyp_mut_ind := Minimality for wf_subtyp Sort Prop
with wf_is_univ_mut_ind := Minimality for wf_is_univ Sort Prop
with wf_ext_eq_mut_ind := Minimality for wf_ext_eq Sort Prop
with wf_unit_eq_mut_ind := Minimality for wf_unit_eq Sort Prop
with wf_modexp_eq_mut_ind := Minimality for wf_modexp_eq Sort Prop.
Combined Scheme syntactic_wf_mut_ind from
  wf_ctx_mut_ind,
  wf_exp_mut_ind,
  wf_exp_eq_mut_ind,
  wf_subtyp_mut_ind,
  wf_is_univ_mut_ind,
  wf_ext_eq_mut_ind,
  wf_unit_eq_mut_ind,
  wf_modexp_eq_mut_ind.

The three-way scheme is the shape of wk_preserves_wf, sub_preserves_wf and sub_eq_preserves_exp: each of them transports the three judgments about a fixed context along an operation, and says nothing about context well-formedness. Generating it as a scheme in its own right (rather than combining the four-way one) means it takes exactly three predicates: the ⊢ Γ premises of rules like wf_typ survive as ordinary hypotheses.

Scheme wf_exp_mind := Minimality for wf_exp Sort Prop
with wf_exp_eq_mind := Minimality for wf_exp_eq Sort Prop
with wf_subtyp_mind := Minimality for wf_subtyp Sort Prop
with wf_is_univ_mind := Minimality for wf_is_univ Sort Prop
with wf_ext_eq_mind := Minimality for wf_ext_eq Sort Prop
with wf_unit_eq_mind := Minimality for wf_unit_eq Sort Prop
with wf_modexp_eq_mind := Minimality for wf_modexp_eq Sort Prop.

  wf_exp_mind,
  wf_exp_eq_mind,
  wf_subtyp_mind,
  wf_is_univ_mind,

  wf_unit_eq_mind,
  wf_modexp_eq_mind.

The two-way scheme is the shape of the soundness fundamental theorem: the gluing model relates contexts and terms, and its subtyping case consumes Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' syntactically, so neither of the two equality judgments needs a predicate.

Scheme wf_ctx_mind' := Minimality for wf_ctx Sort Prop
with wf_exp_mind' := Minimality for wf_exp Sort Prop
with wf_is_univ_mind' := Minimality for wf_is_univ Sort Prop.
Combined Scheme syntactic_wf_ctx_exp_mut_ind from
  wf_ctx_mind',
  wf_exp_mind',
  wf_is_univ_mind'.

The global subset: the shape of wf_global_canon and gsub_preserves_global.

Scheme wf_gentry_mut_ind := Minimality for wf_gentry Sort Prop
with wf_gmod_mut_ind := Minimality for wf_gmod Sort Prop.
Combined Scheme global_wf_mut_ind from
  wf_gentry_mut_ind,
  wf_gmod_mut_ind.

The whole block, for a statement that has to cross between the two directions — the term judgments appeal to ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ and the global ones to typing, so presupposition is proved here or not at all.

Scheme wf_ctx_mut_ind_all := Minimality for wf_ctx Sort Prop
with wf_exp_mut_ind_all := Minimality for wf_exp Sort Prop
with wf_exp_eq_mut_ind_all := Minimality for wf_exp_eq Sort Prop
with wf_subtyp_mut_ind_all := Minimality for wf_subtyp Sort Prop
with wf_is_univ_mut_ind_all := Minimality for wf_is_univ Sort Prop
with wf_ext_eq_mut_ind_all := Minimality for wf_ext_eq Sort Prop
with wf_unit_eq_mut_ind_all := Minimality for wf_unit_eq Sort Prop
with wf_modexp_eq_mut_ind_all := Minimality for wf_modexp_eq Sort Prop
with wf_gentry_mut_ind_all := Minimality for wf_gentry Sort Prop
with wf_gmod_mut_ind_all := Minimality for wf_gmod Sort Prop
with wf_gstack_mut_ind_all := Minimality for wf_gstack Sort Prop.
Combined Scheme wf_mut_ind_all from
  wf_ctx_mut_ind_all,
  wf_exp_mut_ind_all,
  wf_exp_eq_mut_ind_all,
  wf_subtyp_mut_ind_all,
  wf_is_univ_mut_ind_all,
  wf_ext_eq_mut_ind_all,
  wf_unit_eq_mut_ind_all,
  wf_modexp_eq_mut_ind_all,
  wf_gentry_mut_ind_all,
  wf_gmod_mut_ind_all,
  wf_gstack_mut_ind_all.

Units

A unit filed at a level, or a frame of the stack, is a body checked by ⊢ᵍᵐ: ⊢ᵍᵘ is not a judgment of its own, but this definition, which the block states inline (wf_gstack_cons). Two further projections are presuppositions, in Presup: ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gu_params U of ⊢ᵍᵐ, hence of ⊢ᵍᵘ, and ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ nil of ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ.

#[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
Record wf_gunit (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (mp : qname) (U : gunit) : Prop := mk_wf_gunit
  { wgu_params : ctx
  ; wgu_body : gmod
  ; wgu_eq : U = gu_body wgu_params wgu_body
  ; wgu_wf : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ wgu_params ⊢ᵍᵐ wgu_body }.
Notation "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵍᵘ U" := (wf_gunit Θ Ξ mp U) : type_scope.

Lemma wf_gunit_intro : forall Θ Ξ mp Δ Φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵍᵘ gu_body Δ Φ.
Proof. intros; econstructor; [ reflexivity | eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_gunit_mod : forall Θ Ξ mp U, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵍᵘ U -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ gu_params U ⊢ᵍᵐ gu_mod U.
Proof. intros * [Δ Φ -> H]; exact H. Qed.

The unit form of the two constructors that file one.

Lemma wf_gstack_cons' : forall Θ Ξ mp U,
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵍᵘ U -> frame_fresh Θ Ξ mp -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ (mp, U) :: Ξ.
Proof. intros * ? [Δ Φ -> ?] ?; apply wf_gstack_cons; assumption. Qed.

Lemma wf_gstack_cons_inv : forall Θ Ξ mp U,
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ (mp, U) :: Ξ -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵍᵘ U /\ frame_fresh Θ Ξ mp.
Proof. inversion 1; subst; eauto using wf_gunit_intro. Qed.

Filing, from the premises of the frame it closes.
Lemma wf_gstack_file' : forall Θ fp U,
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ nil -> Θ ⍮ nil ⍮ q_abs fp nil ⊢ᵍᵘ U -> gds_lookup Θ fp = None -> ⊢ᵍ (fp, U) :: Θ ⍮ nil.
Proof. intros * ? ? ?; apply wf_gstack_file, wf_gstack_cons'; [ assumption | assumption | split; [ assumption | reflexivity ] ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_gstack_file_inv : forall Θ fp U,
    ⊢ᵍ (fp, U) :: Θ ⍮ nil -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ nil /\ Θ ⍮ nil ⍮ q_abs fp nil ⊢ᵍᵘ U /\ gds_lookup Θ fp = None.
Proof.
  inversion 1; subst.
  match goal with H : ⊢ᵍ _ ⍮ _ :: nil |- _ => destruct (wf_gstack_cons_inv _ _ _ _ H) as (? & ? & [? _]) end; auto.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Constructors wf_ctx wf_exp wf_exp_eq wf_subtyp wf_is_univ ctx_lookup ctx_lookup_def : mctt.

Lemma let_ann_none : forall A, let_ann None A.
Proof. intros; left; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma let_ann_some : forall A, let_ann (Some A) A.
Proof. intros; right; reflexivity. Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve let_ann_none let_ann_some : mctt.

Ltac solve_let_ann := first [ apply let_ann_some | eassumption | apply let_ann_none ].

The annotations of the local definitions in context, as the two cases.
Ltac destruct_let_ann :=
  repeat match goal with H : let_ann _ _ |- _ => destruct H as [-> | ->] end; cbv beta iota in *.

#[export]
Hint Constructors wf_ext_eq wf_unit_eq wf_modexp_eq : mctt.

The two instances of wf_gentry_def, with a body and without (an axiom), whose conclusions name the entry as it is filed.
Lemma wf_gentry_def_body : forall Θ Ξ mp b pv A M i,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ M : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ ge_def b pv (ctx_pi (gs_tele Ξ) A) (Some (ctx_fn (gs_tele Ξ) M)).
Proof.
  intros * HA HM; change (Some (ctx_fn (gs_tele Ξ) M)) with (option_map (ctx_fn (gs_tele Ξ)) (Some M)).
  eapply wf_gentry_def; [ exact HA | intros ? [= <-]; exact HM ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_gentry_def_axiom : forall Θ Ξ mp b pv A i,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ ge_def b pv (ctx_pi (gs_tele Ξ) A) None.
Proof.
  intros * HA; change (@None exp) with (option_map (ctx_fn (gs_tele Ξ)) None).
  eapply wf_gentry_def; [ exact HA | discriminate ].
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Constructors wf_gentry wf_gmod wf_gstack : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_gentry_def_body wf_gentry_def_axiom : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_gunit_intro : mctt.

Weakening and Substitution Typing

These are the derived judgments. They are records, not inductive relations: a weakening or a substitution is well-typed exactly when it sends each binding of its source context to something of the correspondingly transported type in its target. Nothing here is recursive, so none of it belongs in the mutual block above; the price is that closure under the operations (Id, _,,_, q, _⨟_) has to be proved, which is what wf_wk_id–wf_wk_compose and wf_sub_id–wf_sub_q do.

Record wf_wk (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ Δ : ctx) (φ : wk) : Prop := wf_wk_intro
{ wf_wk_dom : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ
; wf_wk_cod : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ
; wf_wk_lookup : forall x A, Δ ∋ #x : A -> Γ ∋ #(φ x) : A[φ]ʷ
A renaming sends a definition to the same definition.
; wf_wk_lookup_def : forall x A M, Δ ∋ #x ≔ M : A -> Γ ∋ #(φ x) ≔ M[φ]ʷ : A[φ]ʷ
A renaming sends a module slot to a slot of the same unit.
; wf_wk_lookup_mod : forall x U, Δ ∋ #x ≔ₘ U -> Γ ∋ #(φ x) ≔ₘ gunit_wk U φ
}.
Notation "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ʷ φ : Δ" := (wf_wk Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ) : type_scope.

Record wf_sub (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ Δ : ctx) (σ : sub) : Prop := wf_sub_intro
{ wf_sub_dom : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ
; wf_sub_cod : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ
; wf_sub_apply : forall x A, Δ ∋ #x : A -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ #x[σ] : A[σ]
A substitution sends a definition to something equal to its body.
; wf_sub_apply_def : forall x A M, Δ ∋ #x ≔ M : A -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ #x[σ] ≈ M[σ] : A[σ]
A substitution sends a module slot to the unit it holds, transported: as a well-formed literal, or as a slot holding that unit.
; wf_sub_apply_mod : forall x U, Δ ∋ #x ≔ₘ U ->
    (σ x = se_mod (me_lit U[σ]ᵘ) /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U[σ]ᵘ ≈ U[σ]ᵘ) \/ exists y, σ x = se_var y /\ Γ ∋ #y ≔ₘ U[σ]ᵘ
}.
Notation "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ : Δ" := (wf_sub Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ) : type_scope.

The type at which the images are equated is A[σ]; it could equally be A[σ'], since sub_eq_preserves_exp shows the two are equal types.
Record wf_sub_eq (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ Δ : ctx) (σ σ' : sub) : Prop := wf_sub_eq_intro
{ wf_sub_eq_left : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ : Δ
; wf_sub_eq_right : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ' : Δ
; wf_sub_eq_apply : forall x A, Δ ∋ #x : A -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ #x[σ] ≈ #x[σ'] : A[σ]
A module slot is sent to equal module expressions.
; wf_sub_eq_apply_mod : forall x U, Δ ∋ #x ≔ₘ U -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ sentry_modexp (σ x) ≈ sentry_modexp (σ' x)
}.
Notation "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ" := (wf_sub_eq Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ σ') : type_scope.

The projections are not registered in mctt: each of them has a conclusion (⊢ Γ, Γ ⊢ˢ σ : Δ) that the corresponding introduction rule also produces, so the pair would let eauto cycle. Lemmas.v states the presuppositions it actually wants as separate lemmas.
wf_wk, wf_sub and wf_sub_eq are all invariant under pointwise equality of the operation: the operation only ever occurs applied to an index or applied to an expression, and both of those respect pointwise equality (exp_wk_Proper, exp_sub_Proper).

#[export]
Instance wf_wk_Proper Θ Ξ Γ Δ : Proper (wk_eq ==> iff) (wf_wk Θ Ξ Γ Δ).
Proof.
  assert (forall φ ψ, wk_eq φ ψ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ʷ φ : Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ʷ ψ : Δ) as Himp.
  {
    intros φ ψ Heq [? ? Hlk Hlkd Hlkm].
    econstructor; try eassumption.
    - intros x A ?.
      replace (ψ x) with (φ x) by apply Heq.
      rewrite <- Heq.
      now apply Hlk.
    - intros x A M ?.
      replace (ψ x) with (φ x) by apply Heq.
      rewrite <- !Heq.
      now apply Hlkd.
    - intros x U ?.
      replace (ψ x) with (φ x) by apply Heq.
      rewrite <- Heq.
      now apply Hlkm.
  }
  intros φ ψ Heq; split; apply Himp; [ assumption | now symmetry ].
Qed.

#[export]
Instance wf_sub_Proper Θ Ξ Γ Δ : Proper (sb_eq ==> iff) (wf_sub Θ Ξ Γ Δ).
Proof.
  assert (forall σ τ, sb_eq σ τ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ : Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ τ : Δ) as Himp.
  {
    intros σ τ Heq [? ? Hap Hapd Hapm].
    econstructor; try eassumption.
    - intros x A ?.
      rewrite <- !Heq.
      now apply Hap.
    - intros x A M ?.
      rewrite <- !Heq.
      now apply Hapd.
    - intros x U HU.
      rewrite <- (Heq x), <- (gunit_sub_sb_eq U σ τ Heq).
      now apply Hapm.
  }
  intros σ τ Heq; split; apply Himp; [ assumption | now symmetry ].
Qed.

Immediate & Independent Presuppositions

The two forms of a literal's typing the proofs below name: at its own sort, the least one, and at sort 0 for a finite one.
Lemma wf_llit_ord : forall {Θ Ξ Γ o},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ 𝕃ᵒ o : Level@(fst o).
Proof. intros; apply wf_llit; [ reflexivity | assumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_llit_fin : forall {Θ Ξ Γ n},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ 𝕃@n : Level.
Proof. intros; apply wf_llit; [ reflexivity | assumption ]. Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_llit_ord wf_llit_fin : mctt.
The side condition of wf_llit and of the literal equations: the tier of a literal is at most the sort.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (fst _ <= _) => cbn [fst]; lia : mctt.

A small universe is a type of every large universe.
Lemma wf_univ_large_tm : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M i n},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨M⟩ : Typeω@i.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ HM; eapply wf_exp_subtyp;
    [ eapply wf_univ, HM | apply wf_typ, HΓ | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large; [ exact HΓ | apply wf_succl, HM ] ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_univ_large : forall {Θ Ξ Γ o i},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ o⟩ : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_univ_large_tm; [ assumption | apply wf_llit_ord; assumption ]. Qed.

The base types are types of every large universe.
Lemma wf_True_large : forall {Θ Ξ Γ i}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ ⊤ : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_exp_subtyp; [ apply wf_True | apply wf_typ | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large ]; first [ eassumption | apply wf_llit_fin; eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_False_large : forall {Θ Ξ Γ i}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ ⊥ : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_exp_subtyp; [ apply wf_False | apply wf_typ | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large ]; first [ eassumption | apply wf_llit_fin; eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_level_large : forall {Θ Ξ Γ i n}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Level@n : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_exp_subtyp; [ apply wf_level | apply wf_typ | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large ]; first [ eassumption | apply wf_llit_fin; eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_level_cong_large : forall {Θ Ξ Γ i n}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Level@n ≈ Level@n : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp; [ apply wf_exp_eq_level_cong | apply wf_typ | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large ]; first [ eassumption | apply wf_llit_fin; eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_True_cong_large : forall {Θ Ξ Γ i}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ ⊤ ≈ ⊤ : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp; [ apply wf_exp_eq_True_cong | apply wf_typ | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large ]; first [ eassumption | apply wf_llit_fin; eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_False_cong_large : forall {Θ Ξ Γ i}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ ⊥ ≈ ⊥ : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp; [ apply wf_exp_eq_False_cong | apply wf_typ | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large ]; first [ eassumption | apply wf_llit_fin; eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_univ_cong_large_tm : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M M' i n},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨M⟩ ≈ Type⟨M'⟩ : Typeω@i.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ HMt HM; eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp;
    [ eapply wf_exp_eq_univ_cong, HM | apply wf_typ, HΓ
    | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large; [ exact HΓ | apply wf_succl, HMt ] ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_univ_cong_large : forall {Θ Ξ Γ o i}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ o⟩ ≈ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ o⟩ : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_exp_eq_univ_cong_large_tm; [ assumption | apply wf_llit_ord; assumption | apply wf_exp_eq_llit_cong; [ reflexivity | assumption ] ]. Qed.

Literal Levels

The literal form of the universe rules, which the closed types and the stage-1 statements are written with: succl 𝕃@n is 𝕃@(S n) and the order on literals is the order on their indices, so the general rules give them back.

The Universe Congruence, Right-Hand Side

Type⟨M⟩ ≈ Type⟨M'⟩ is stated at Type⟨succl M⟩, so presupposition for the right-hand side has to move Type⟨M'⟩ from Type⟨succl M'⟩ there. That is a subtyping, by the level equation maxl M' M ≈ M, which needs reflexivity at M only — and M ≈ M is M ≈ M' composed with its symmetry, so no induction over typing is needed here.
Lemma wf_exp_eq_maxl_right : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M M' n},
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ maxl M' M ≈ M : Level@n.
Proof.
  intros * HM H.
  assert (HMM : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M : Level@n)
    by (eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [ exact H | apply wf_exp_eq_sym, H ]).
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
    [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_cong; [ apply wf_exp_eq_sym, H | exact HMM ]
    | apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_idem, HM ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_subtyp_suniv_succl_eq : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M M' n},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M' : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨succl M'⟩ ⊆ Type⟨succl M⟩.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ HM HM' H; eapply wf_subtyp_suniv;
    [ exact HΓ | apply wf_succl, HM' | apply wf_succl, HM |].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
    [ apply wf_exp_eq_sym, wf_exp_eq_succl_maxl; [ exact HM' | exact HM ]
    | apply wf_exp_eq_succl_cong, wf_exp_eq_maxl_right; [ exact HM | exact H ] ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_univ_cong_right : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M M' n},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M' : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨M'⟩ : Type⟨succl M⟩.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ HM HM' H.
  assert (HT : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨succl M⟩ : Typeω@0)
    by (eapply wf_univ_large_tm; [ exact HΓ | apply wf_succl, HM ]).
  eapply wf_exp_subtyp;
    [ eapply wf_univ, HM' | exact HT
    | eapply wf_subtyp_suniv_succl_eq; [ exact HΓ | exact HM | exact HM' | exact H ] ].
Qed.

Below a literal, below its successor.
Lemma wf_exp_eq_maxl_succl_right : forall {Θ Ξ Γ} o o' n,
    fst o <= n ->
    fst o' <= n ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ maxl (𝕃ᵒ o) (𝕃ᵒ o') ≈ 𝕃ᵒ o' : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ maxl (𝕃ᵒ o) (succl (𝕃ᵒ o')) ≈ succl (𝕃ᵒ o') : Level@n.
Proof.
  intros * Ho Ho' HΓ H.
  assert (HM : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ 𝕃ᵒ o : Level@n) by (apply wf_llit; assumption).
  assert (HN : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ 𝕃ᵒ o' : Level@n) by (apply wf_llit; assumption).
  assert (HSN : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ succl (𝕃ᵒ o') : Level@n) by (apply wf_succl, HN).
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
    [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_cong;
      [ apply wf_exp_eq_llit_cong; assumption
      | apply wf_exp_eq_sym, wf_exp_eq_maxl_succl, HN ] |].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [ apply wf_exp_eq_sym, wf_exp_eq_maxl_assoc; [ exact HM | exact HN | exact HSN ] |].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
    [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_cong;
      [ exact H | apply wf_exp_eq_succl_cong, wf_exp_eq_llit_cong; assumption ] |].
  apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_succl, HN.
Qed.

Two literals of one tier, ω·a + b below ω·a + (b + d).
Lemma wf_exp_eq_maxl_llit_tier : forall {Θ Ξ Γ} a b d n,
    a <= n ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ maxl (𝕃ᵒ(a, b)) (𝕃ᵒ(a, d + b)) ≈ 𝕃ᵒ(a, d + b) : Level@n.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Γ a b d n Ha HΓ; induction d as [| d IH]; cbn.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_idem, wf_llit; assumption.
  - eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
      [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_cong;
        [ apply wf_exp_eq_llit_cong; assumption | apply wf_exp_eq_llit_succl; assumption ] |].
    eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
      [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_succl_right; [ exact Ha | exact Ha | exact HΓ | exact IH ] |].
    apply wf_exp_eq_sym, wf_exp_eq_llit_succl; assumption.
Qed.

The limit ω·a' is above every literal of a lower tier: absorption, at the sort just below a', moved up to n.
Lemma wf_exp_eq_maxl_llit_limit : forall {Θ Ξ Γ} a b a' n,
    a < a' ->
    a' <= n ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ maxl (𝕃ᵒ(a, b)) (𝕃ᵒ(a', 0)) ≈ 𝕃ᵒ(a', 0) : Level@n.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Γ a b a' n Ha Hn HΓ.
  destruct a' as [| m]; [ lia |].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp;
    [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_absorb, wf_llit; [ cbn; lia | exact HΓ ]
    | apply (wf_level_large (i := 0)), HΓ
    | apply wf_subtyp_level; [ exact Hn | exact HΓ ] ].
Qed.

A literal of a lower tier is below every literal of a higher one.
Lemma wf_exp_eq_maxl_llit_lower : forall {Θ Ξ Γ} a b a' d n,
    a < a' ->
    a' <= n ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ maxl (𝕃ᵒ(a, b)) (𝕃ᵒ(a', d)) ≈ 𝕃ᵒ(a', d) : Level@n.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Γ a b a' d n Ha Hn HΓ; induction d as [| d IH].
  - apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_llit_limit; assumption.
  - eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
      [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_cong;
        [ apply wf_exp_eq_llit_cong; [ cbn; lia | exact HΓ ] | apply wf_exp_eq_llit_succl; assumption ] |].
    eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
      [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_succl_right; [ cbn; lia | exact Hn | exact HΓ | exact IH ] |].
    apply wf_exp_eq_sym, wf_exp_eq_llit_succl; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_maxl_llit_ole : forall {Θ Ξ Γ} o o' n,
    ole o o' ->
    fst o' <= n ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ maxl (𝕃ᵒ o) (𝕃ᵒ o') ≈ 𝕃ᵒ o' : Level@n.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Γ [a b] [a' b'] n Hle Hn HΓ; unfold ole in Hle; cbn in Hle, Hn.
  destruct Hle as [Ha | [<- Hb]].
  - apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_llit_lower; assumption.
  - replace b' with ((b' - b) + b) by lia; apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_llit_tier; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_subtyp_small_large_lit : forall {Θ Ξ Γ o i},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ o⟩ ⊆ Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_subtyp_small_large; [ assumption | apply wf_llit_ord; assumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_subtyp_suniv_ole : forall {Θ Ξ Γ o o'},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    ole o o' ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ o⟩ ⊆ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ o'⟩.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ Hle.
  assert (fst o <= fst o') by (destruct o, o'; unfold ole in Hle; cbn in *; lia).
  eapply (wf_subtyp_suniv _ _ _ (fst o'));
    [ assumption | apply wf_llit; assumption | apply wf_llit; [ reflexivity | assumption ]
    | apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_llit_ole; [ assumption | reflexivity | assumption ] ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_subtyp_suniv_succl : forall {Θ Ξ Γ a b},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨succl 𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩ ⊆ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, S b)⟩.
Proof.
  intros; eapply (wf_subtyp_suniv _ _ _ a);
    [ assumption | apply wf_succl, wf_llit; [ reflexivity | assumption ] | apply wf_llit; [ reflexivity | assumption ] |].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
    [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_cong;
      [ apply wf_exp_eq_sym, wf_exp_eq_llit_succl; [ reflexivity | assumption ]
      | apply wf_exp_eq_llit_cong; [ reflexivity | assumption ] ]
    | apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_idem, wf_llit; [ reflexivity | assumption ] ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_univ_lit : forall {Θ Ξ Γ a b},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩ : Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, S b)⟩.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ.
  assert (H1 : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩ : Type⟨succl 𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩)
    by (eapply (wf_univ _ _ _ a), wf_llit; [ reflexivity | exact HΓ ]).
  assert (H2 : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, S b)⟩ : Typeω@0) by (apply wf_univ_large; exact HΓ).
  eapply wf_exp_subtyp; [ exact H1 | exact H2 | apply wf_subtyp_suniv_succl, HΓ ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_univ_cong_lit : forall {Θ Ξ Γ a b},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩ ≈ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩ : Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, S b)⟩.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ.
  assert (H1 : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩ ≈ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩ : Type⟨succl 𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩)
    by (eapply (wf_exp_eq_univ_cong _ _ _ a), wf_exp_eq_llit_cong; [ reflexivity | exact HΓ ]).
  assert (H2 : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, S b)⟩ : Typeω@0) by (apply wf_univ_large; exact HΓ).
  eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp; [ exact H1 | exact H2 | apply wf_subtyp_suniv_succl, HΓ ].
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_univ_lit wf_exp_eq_univ_cong_lit : mctt.

The universe at an index u, as a term of the large universe just above it: Typeω@j is in Typeω@(S j), and every small universe is in Typeω@0.
Lemma wf_ulvl_tm : forall {Θ Ξ Γ} {u : uidx},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ ulvl_tm u : Typeω@(ulvl_above u).
Proof. intros ? ? ? []; [ apply wf_univ_large | apply wf_typ ]. Qed.

A universe is closed, so no substitution reaches it.
Lemma exp_sub_ulvl_tm : forall u σ, (ulvl_tm u)[σ] = ulvl_tm u.
Proof. intros [] ?; reflexivity. Qed.

As hints, these fix a large universe the goal leaves open to Typeω@0 (a small one to Type@0), so that a search never ends with an uninstantiated level.
Ltac fix_open_level i := first [ is_evar i; first [ unify i 0 | unify i oz ] | idtac ].

wf_subtyp_small_large constrains nothing about the small level, so as a constructor hint it would leave it open whenever the left-hand side is; it applies only to a known small universe.
#[export]
Remove Hints wf_subtyp_small_large : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ Type⟨_⟩ ⊆ Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; eapply wf_subtyp_small_large : mctt.
The literal form of the two hints above keeps the depth of a search that only meets small universes at literal levels.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ _⟩ ⊆ Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; apply wf_subtyp_small_large_lit : mctt.

#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ Type⟨_⟩ : Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; eapply wf_univ_large_tm : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ _⟩ : Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; apply wf_univ_large : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ Level@_ : Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; apply wf_level_large : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ Level@_ ≈ Level@_ : Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; apply wf_exp_eq_level_cong_large : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ ⊤ : Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; apply wf_True_large : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ ⊥ : Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; apply wf_False_large : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ ⊤ ≈ ⊤ : Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; apply wf_exp_eq_True_cong_large : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ ⊥ ≈ ⊥ : Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; apply wf_exp_eq_False_cong_large : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ Type⟨_⟩ ≈ Type⟨_⟩ : Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; eapply wf_exp_eq_univ_cong_large_tm : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ _⟩ ≈ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ _⟩ : Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; apply wf_exp_eq_univ_cong_large : mctt.

The Context of a Judgment

Every judgment presupposes its context well formed. These come first, each by an induction that reads it off whichever premise is stated at Γ.

Lemma presup_ext_eq_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; auto.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_ext_eq_ctx : mctt.

Lemma presup_unit_eq_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U U'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; mautosolve 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_unit_eq_ctx : mctt.

Lemma presup_modexp_eq_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ H H'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; mautosolve 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_modexp_eq_ctx : mctt.

A unit equivalence presupposes the reflexive instances of both sides.
Lemma wf_unit_eq_refl_left : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U U'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_unit_eq_trans; [ eassumption | apply wf_unit_eq_sym; eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_unit_eq_refl_right : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U U'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U' ≈ U'.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_unit_eq_trans; [ apply wf_unit_eq_sym; eassumption | eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_modexp_eq_refl_left : forall {Θ Ξ Γ H H'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_me_trans; [ eassumption | apply wf_me_sym; eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_modexp_eq_refl_right : forall {Θ Ξ Γ H H'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H' ≈ H'.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_me_trans; [ apply wf_me_sym; eassumption | eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma ctx_decomp_mod : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ₘ U ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U.
Proof.
  inversion 1; eauto using presup_unit_eq_ctx.
Qed.

Corollary ctx_decomp_mod_left : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ₘ U -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof. intros * ?%ctx_decomp_mod; easy. Qed.

Corollary ctx_decomp_mod_unit : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ₘ U -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U.
Proof. intros * ?%ctx_decomp_mod; easy. Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve ctx_decomp_mod_left ctx_decomp_mod_unit : mctt.

Lemma presup_exp_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M A}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; mautosolve 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_exp_ctx : mctt.

Lemma presup_exp_eq_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M M' A}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; mautosolve 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_exp_eq_ctx : mctt.

Lemma presup_is_univ_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵤ U -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  inversion 1; mautosolve 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_is_univ_ctx : mctt.

Lemma presup_subtyp_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A B}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ B -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; mautosolve 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_subtyp_ctx : mctt.

The two instances of wf_pi and of its congruence, at a large universe and at a small one.
Lemma wf_pi_large : forall Θ Ξ Γ i A B,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ A ⊢ B : Typeω@i -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Π A B : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros * HA HB; eapply wf_pi; [ apply wf_is_univ_large; eapply presup_exp_ctx, HA | exact HA | exact HB ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_pi_lvl : forall Θ Ξ Γ n L A B,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ L : Level@n -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Type⟨L⟩ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ A ⊢ B : Type⟨L[↑]ʷ⟩ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Π A B : Type⟨L⟩.
Proof. intros * HL HA HB; eapply wf_pi; [ eapply wf_is_univ_small, HL | exact HA | exact HB ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_pi_cong_large : forall Θ Ξ Γ i A A' B B',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Typeω@i -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ A ⊢ B ≈ B' : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Π A B ≈ Π A' B' : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros * HA HAA HB; eapply wf_exp_eq_pi_cong; [ apply wf_is_univ_large; eapply presup_exp_ctx, HA | exact HA | exact HAA | exact HB ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_pi_cong_lvl : forall Θ Ξ Γ n L A A' B B',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ L : Level@n -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Type⟨L⟩ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type⟨L⟩ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ A ⊢ B ≈ B' : Type⟨L[↑]ʷ⟩ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Π A B ≈ Π A' B' : Type⟨L⟩.
Proof. intros * HL HA HAA HB; eapply wf_exp_eq_pi_cong; [ eapply wf_is_univ_small, HL | exact HA | exact HAA | exact HB ]. Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_pi_large wf_pi_lvl wf_exp_eq_pi_cong_large wf_exp_eq_pi_cong_lvl : mctt.

A universe is a type.
Lemma wf_is_univ_typ : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵤ U -> exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ U : Typeω@i.
Proof.
  inversion 1; subst; [ exists (S i); apply wf_typ; assumption |].
  exists 0; eapply wf_exp_subtyp; [ eapply wf_univ; eassumption | apply wf_typ; mauto 2 | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large; mauto 2 ].
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_is_univ_typ : mctt.

Lemma presup_subtyp_right : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A B}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ B -> exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ B : Typeω@i.
Proof.
  induction 1; mautosolve.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_subtyp_right : mctt.

Subtyping Rules without Extra Arguments


Lemma wf_exp_subtyp' : forall Θ Ξ Γ A A' M,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A'.
Proof.
  intros.
  assert (exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A' : Typeω@i) as [] by mauto.
  econstructor; mauto.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_exp_subtyp' : mctt.
#[export]
Remove Hints wf_exp_subtyp : mctt.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_subtyp' : forall Θ Ξ Γ A A' M M',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A'.
Proof.
  intros.
  assert (exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A' : Typeω@i) as [] by mauto.
  econstructor; mauto.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_exp_eq_subtyp' : mctt.
#[export]
Remove Hints wf_exp_eq_subtyp : mctt.

Term Equality is a PER

Reflexivity at a well-typed term is not available here — it needs an induction over typing, so it lives in Core.Syntactic.System.Lemmas together with the PERElem instance that lets saturate_refl use it. The same goes for wf_sub_eq, whose symmetry and transitivity need sub_eq_preserves_exp to move between the types A[σ] and A[σ'].

#[export]
Instance wf_exp_eq_PER Θ Ξ Γ A : PER (wf_exp_eq Θ Ξ Γ A).
Proof.
  split.
  - eauto using wf_exp_eq_sym.
  - eauto using wf_exp_eq_trans.
Qed.

#[export]
Instance wf_subtyp_Transitive Θ Ξ Γ : Transitive (wf_subtyp Θ Ξ Γ).
Proof.
  hnf; mauto.
Qed.

Add Parametric Morphism Θ Ξ Γ T : (wf_exp_eq Θ Ξ Γ T)
    with signature wf_exp_eq Θ Ξ Γ T ==> eq ==> iff as wf_exp_eq_morphism_iff1.
Proof.
  split; mauto.
Qed.

Add Parametric Morphism Θ Ξ Γ T : (wf_exp_eq Θ Ξ Γ T)
    with signature eq ==> wf_exp_eq Θ Ξ Γ T ==> iff as wf_exp_eq_morphism_iff2.
Proof.
  split; mauto.
Qed.
